adjudications.source_grounded_explanation: The fresh verifier and independent reviewer both inspected physical pages 5 and 6 of the hash-matched Activate PDF. Page 5 supports the $1.7T to $2.0T forecast, $302B growth, 4.1% CAGR, and approximately 3% global GDP CAGR. Page 6 supports $128B at 5.7% for cost of Internet access, $108B at 4.7% for advertising, and $66B at 2.3% for paid content, including the fixed-broadband, wireless, and mobile-Internet-access definition. The page sets match, so this adjudication records the corrected source location without reusing the historical rejected binding.
